name: ReliablePartnerBadge
description: Vastuu Group "Luotettava Kumppani" trust mark, language-matched, linking to the corresponding Reliable Partner report PDF.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the badge link; Enter activates it (native anchor).
ariaRequirements: the badge image carries a translated alt describing the certification, never an empty alt, because the link has no other accessible name
the link opens a PDF in a new tab and says so in its title/alt so the context change is not a surprise
when rendered unlinked (href={null}) the alt still carries the meaning

href.description: Link target. Omit for the language-matched Reliable Partner report PDF; pass null to render unlinked.

dense: language-matched Vastuu Group trust mark (fi/sv/en) linking to that language's Reliable Partner report PDF; sm/md/lg heights
